about: Package REF6: 100 simulated players per map (seeds ref6-1 .. ref6-100), each with its own collection from the game's rewards and pack draws and a legal deck built from what the map's optimised decks pick (tools/ref6/ladder.js header). counts: card -> copies; leader kept out of the deck; level: every card at the Map reference's level; strength: the deck's mean win rate over the map's road fights from the measure named in strengthTag (tools/ref6/measure.js --strength).

rule.legal: cards the player holds at the map; no faction card; copies within the rarity's copy cap and the copies owned; 20 cards (no map rarity cap)
rule.leader: strongest legal card that may lead (ref5_prog chooseLeader), else wandering-traveller
rule.deck: the player's legal cards by library value (mean copies over the map's optimised decks), see the tool header
